title: Sentences

oil.sentenceGloss: I buy sunflower oil for the salad.
oil.note: Accusative: олія is what is bought, so it takes the accusative.

butter.sentenceGloss: I spread butter on the bread.
butter.note: Accusative: масло is what is spread, so it takes the accusative.

expiry.sentenceGloss: Before buying I check the shelf life.
expiry.note: Genitive: термін придатності is a fixed phrase in the genitive.

cost.sentenceGloss: How much does this loaf cost?
cost.note: Present tense: скільки коштує — how much does it cost.

carrots.note: Accusative: ріжу takes the accusative — what is cut.

summary: Use the lemma or the meaning fixed by the sentence to supply the missing form.
